item.title: No CathNews on Monday
item.description: CathNews will not be published on Monday, March 9, due to public holidays in the ACT, South Australia, Tasmania and Victoria.

item.title: Ruined honeymoon turns into charming romantic comedy
item.description: In “Solo Mio”, a stranded groom in Rome finds his ruined honeymoon transformed by a determined local and a few meddling travellers. Source: Australian Catholics.

item.title: Sudanese bishops express distress after massacre
item.description: Catholic bishops in Sudan and South Sudan have expressed distress at the brutal killing of nearly 178 people in northern South Sudan on March 2. Source: OSV News.

item.title: Cathedral light show attracts thousands of visitors
item.description: The interior of St Francis Xavier’s Cathedral in Adelaide has been transformed by stunning projections as part of the Chiaroscuro Adelaide Fringe show. Source: The Southern Cross.

item.title: For many young Australians, democracy not the automatic option
item.description: Fewer than half of young Australians believe democracy is always preferable to other forms of government, as trust in institutions wanes, new research has found. Source: SBS News.

item.title: Indigenous Catholics share common experiences in New Zealand
item.description: Participants in the second International Conference on Catholic Indigenous have been struck by the similar experiences and a common resilience across the four participating nations. Source: NZCBC.

item.title: Brisbane Maronite priest fears for his village in south Lebanon
item.description: Missile and drone strikes are escalating across the Middle East, and Brisbane Maronite priest Fr Fadi Salame says the people of his village in southern Lebanon feel like they have “no say” in what happens next. Source: The Catholic Leader.

item.title: Paralympians show ‘no one is defined by limitation alone’
item.description: Australia’s Winter Paralympians show the strength of the human spirit and remind the world that no one is defined by limitation alone, says Townsville Bishop Tim Harris. Source: ACBC Media Blog.

item.title: Pope imagines a world without war in his latest prayer
item.description: Pope Leo XIV’s prayer intention for the month of March is for disarmament and peace. Source: EWTN News.
